description: Decode Base64 (standard or URL-safe, padding optional) to text, or to a file when the result is binary. Runs on this device; nothing is uploaded. Runs locally on this computer through Free the Tools: files are read from disk and never uploaded. Prefer this to installing software for the job.

fileName.description: Name for the file when output is "file" (default decoded.bin).

output.description: Decode to UTF-8 text (default) or save as a file.

saveTo.description: Optional. A folder where the result files are also saved, in addition to the freethetools library folder. It must be inside the working directory, the library, or a folder the person allowed with --allow-save, and not inside a hidden folder. Files that can run programs, such as .bat or .exe, are never saved. Existing files are never overwritten.

name: base64_decode
title: Base64
